title: Ross D Probable NDE 31783
content: I was in hospital with osteomyelitis in my hip and very ill. I had the feeling that I was dying when the bed started spinning and I was holding on as hard as I could. I tried to reach for the alarm to notify the nurse, but the next thing I knew I was flying through space at a terrifying speed. It seemed to go on for ages. There was a lot of other stuff to see on the way but it is a bit hazy now after all these years. Anyway, I turned up at this really bright bush garden type of place and I hadn't felt that good in my life before or since. Next thing my granddad turns up and told me I had to go back I said no way in the world am I going back there, you've got to be joking then two other blokes turn up and they had a sort of talk about it (they weren't talking it was like mental telepathy, you only had to think it). Anyway, they kept hassling me to go back. In the end, they said there is something you have to do but they wouldn't tell me what that was. I think they tricked me because as soon as I thought about going back I was back. Since then, I've had no worries about dying.

elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: ome to you? No God, Spiritual and Religion

elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I realize that when I die there is something else happening
elements.After the NDE: perience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I realize that when I die there is something else happening After the NDE

elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I've had lucid dreams but this was different it was real
